chapter: Running the studio in the rock and roll boom
title: Effect of rock and roll on business; round-the-clock sessions and mixers
summary: R&B got the outside attention but early rock brought the most work; Matassa worked days without going home and let trusted people such as Seth David mix sessions.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
